name: – Bernd Lange – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the approval, on behalf of the Union, of the amendment of Article 36 of the International Agreement on Olive Oil and Table Olives, 2015
part_text:
The European Union is part of a global agreement on olive oil and table olives. That agreement runs out at the end of 2026. Its member countries agreed in 2024 to change one article so the deal can be extended by five years. The European Parliament is asked to approve this change so the Council can adopt it in time. The report recommends saying yes.

- **What changes:** One article of the olive oil agreement is amended so the deal can be extended by five years.
- **Who it affects:** The European Union, its member states, and everyone in the olive oil and table olives trade.
- **What happens next:** Parliament votes on approval; if given, the Council adopts the decision so the extension takes effect on time.
